extracted_fields.document_title: Energy Saving Action Plan for PAT Cycle-VIII (2023-2026)

entries.item_description: Installed new 9MW efficient TG set of Triveni make, inplace of two older turbines 6MW & 3MW running in Syncronization. Significant reduction in SSC.
Old metal halide lights (Sodium vapors) replaced with L.E.D lights.
Installed level controller in back water of M/C section.
Drives installed in M/C chest PP of PM-1.
Disperser operation stopped in 22,25 & 28 B.F container board by changing raw material composition & re engineering process.
Since Disperser operation stopped in 22,25 & 28 B.F container board, resulting steam saving of 2.8 Tons/ Hr.
In Pulp Mill all Poacher Pumps interlocked with its agitator, resulting 200KWH energy saved /day.
Installed Condensate vaccum Pump in both machine to save steam. Expected Savings of 0.2MT of steam on Per MT of Paper.
Cooling Tower Pump RPM reduced from 1450 to 1300.
Proposal made and capex approved for changing of old Energy inefficient motors with IE3 Energy efficient motors from 75KW to 160KW.
Old Slip ring motors install in refiners needs to be changed with IE3 Energy efficient motors.
Drives need to be install in LC Pulper-1 & LC Pulper-2.
